reuse.why: Builds the new rule on top of the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and getNextDate and replaces every caller of the old helper with one shared applyWeekendRule.

duplication.why: The two inline skipWeekend ternaries in schedule-template and the one in getUpcomingDates are removed in favour of the shared function; only the look-ahead factor of 7 is repeated (OCCURRENCE_LOOKAHEAD vs `count * 7`).

placement.why: The weekend rule lives in shared/schedules.ts alongside the existing weekend and next-date helpers that client and server already share.

scope.why: Focused on the weekend rule; the rule-utils data key rename (weekendSolve to weekendSolveMode, plus frequency) is needed so the stored data matches the rule's input, and a release note is added.

maintainability.why: A single applyWeekendRule taking the schedule's config decides whether and how to move or drop a date, though callers must now cope with a null result and the look-ahead bound is a magic number in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and the schedule template all go through applyWeekendRule; the old helper is made module-private.

disguised_duplication.where: The previously copied skipWeekend ternaries were deleted, not reshaped.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts applyWeekendRule, used by getNextDate (and so getNextDateAfter), server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts.
